intake.description: Our 4-person accounts payable team processes about 300 invoices a week. Each takes 10 minutes to key in; we think AI could cut 7 minutes. Clerks cost us $38 an hour loaded.
Support team of 12 answers 1,500 tickets a month. Drafting a reply takes 8 minutes; AI drafts would save about 5 minutes, and agents would spend 1 minute checking each. Loaded cost $45/hour.
Our 6 maintenance planners write roughly 40 work orders a week, half an hour each, and an AI assistant could save 15 minutes per order. Planner cost is $55/hr.
Sales ops: 3 analysts build 20 proposals a month at about 3 hours each. AI could save 2 hours per proposal but someone would need 30 minutes to review it. Analysts are $70 an hour.
HR screens 5,000 resumes a year with two recruiters. Each takes 6 minutes; AI summaries might save 4 minutes.
Legal reviews 600 NDAs a year, 45 minutes each. An AI first pass saves 30 minutes, but attorneys must spend 10 minutes checking it. Blended cost is $120/hour for a team of 5.
We want to use AI for marketing emails. Not sure about volumes yet.
Field service writes 250 visit reports a day across 50 technicians, 12 minutes each; AI built from voice notes saves 9 minutes per report. Technicians cost $60/hr loaded and work 250 days a year.

memo.title: Predictive maintenance
memo.context: Manufacturing plant, model tested on 3,000 unseen records.

facts.Readiness verdict: Fix first: workflow fit and user trust score below 2.5 of 5

memo.title: AI work-order assistant
memo.context: 6 maintenance planners at one plant each write work orders that take about 20 minutes by hand. A 30-alert pilot found the AI's draft had the wrong cause in 17% of cases and some drafts mentioned computer parts, so every draft is reviewed. The tool must be connected to the plant's maintenance system.
